entities.name: Mageta
entities.description: Ferocious Jamuraan general who led Kipamu forces against the Keldons.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Inspector who toured the troops and later led counterattacks with Mageta.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: Jamuraan force using mechanical ants and crabs.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Organizer of the campaign alongside Barrin and Teferi.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: Keldon who made the last attempt to defeat the Kipamu League.

entities.name: Kwende
entities.description: Mageta's descendant who tried to avenge him.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: Took control of the army after Mageta was wounded.

events.summary: Mageta guides Barrin's inspection of the troops from Arsenal City and Kinymu, boasting of mechanical ants and crabs.
events.quote: Mageta was the commanding officer who met him and guided Barrin's tour.

events.summary: Mageta narrowly survives his army's defeat by the Keldons and fights his way back to Arsenal City.
events.quote: Mageta narrowly survived the subsequent defeat of his army at the hands of the Keldons

events.summary: During the siege of Arsenal City, Mageta leads a counterattack that wins the crucial battle.
events.quote: Mageta led the foot soldiers in a counterattack.

events.summary: Mageta and Barrin lead counterattacks; Mageta fights Latulla's last attempt and routs the Keldons.
events.quote: When Latulla made the last attempt to defeat the Kipamu League in battle Mageta once again led his troops from the front line.

events.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out while Mageta is in Ki'pamu.
events.quote: when the entire country was phased out by Teferi

events.summary: Mageta is badly wounded when Kaervek's Amber Prison shatters but survives; Sidar Jabari takes over the army.
events.quote: Mageta was badly wounded when Kaervek 's Amber Prison shattered, but he survived.

relations.quote: he looked fairly similar to the Keldon warriors he battled
Mageta and Barrin led the counterattacks against the retreating Keldons.
his descendant Kwende tried to avenge him
